newsitem.title: USA: Fuji Photo wins contract with Ritz - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Photo wins contract with Ritz - WSJ.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd has won an exclusive agreement to supply paper to Ritz Camera Centers Inc, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The newspaper said Fuji outbid Eastman Kodak Co for the contract with the chain.
It said Fuji and Ritz declined to comment on the value or the length of the contract.
The chain's head, David Ritz, was quoted as saying the chain chose Fuji in order to distinguish itself from its competitors, who use Kodak paper.
Fuji already supplies the chain with chemicals, the newspaper said.
